summary: Allied Gold Corp filed Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1, a Statement of Executive Compensation for the year ended December 31, 2025. The filing details board director compensation, including annual retainers, meeting fees, and one-time grants of stock options and DSUs, with specific amounts per director. There are no transaction terms, merger considerations, premiums, or special-situation mechanics. This is a routine executive compensation disclosure by a foreign private issuer. No action or event triggers a special-situation classification.
